applicant.organisation: Student research group 'Lab 4' at TU Graz

purpose: We are hiring three paid student assistants and want to use regional illness figures as a screening factor when shortlisting applicants, so that our project is not slowed down by sick days.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
